title: Which Egg Has the Prize?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg is hiding the secret prize? Pick your egg — blue, gold, or pink — and find out if you were RIGHT! 🥚✨ Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Kidify #FunForKids #EggChallenge #PrizeReveal

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a GIANT prize! Which one is it?
You've got three choices — the blue egg, the gold egg, or the pink egg!
scenes.visual_prompt: blue gold pink Easter eggs row

scenes.narration: Lock in your answer! Three… two… one!
Let's crack open the blue egg first… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
Now the pink egg… oh wow, it's a pile of socks! Nope, not the prize!
That means the GOLD egg has the prize! Open it up… it's a giant chocolate cake!
Did you pick the gold egg? Nice job! Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it gets trickier!
